text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from Toronto and East York Community Council to extend the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Tecumseth Street, between King Street West and Niagara Street from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week and 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. By extending the overnight on-street permit parking hours residents will have improved parking flexibility and the Parking Enforcement Unit, Toronto Police Service, can effectively control long term parking by non-residents through tagging and towing operations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Tecumseth Street, between King Street West and Niagara Street from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week to 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week and 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. 2. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one hour from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Tecumseth Street, from Niagara Street to Wellington Street West. 3. Amended the existing parking for a maximum period of one hour from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Tecumseth Street, from Wellington Street West to King Street West, to be in effect from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. 4. Approved the prohibition of heavy trucks on Tecumseth Street, from Niagara Street to King Street West.
